items.title: Ralph Emerson Brown and Jasper Taylor Interview, 1961-05-23
items.q: You don't remember Wally Bishop was with him? He played with him for a while.

ctx.x: Well I can't remember just now.
You don't know who was from Chicago. You don't remember Wally Bishop was with him? He played with him for a while. No, I can't say just who was with Jimmy.

I was in one night because I think I knew all this fellas. I think he took his regular six pieces I think he took to New York. He was six or maybe seven. I knew those fellas but right now I can't just call their names off. And he always had a nice band, six or seven pieces. I never heard this big band except I heard this guy here in New York, which wasn't his band, but the guys that they put in there.
